post_measurement_change: The allocator helper's cfg(test) import was moved inside its test for harness=false Clippy compatibility. Non-test code is unchanged; source hashes below describe the measured source.
optimization: rustc -O (opt-level 3), edition 2024; default target CPU; no LTO flags; default codegen units; debug assertions disabled
dependencies_and_features: Standalone core source and existing benchmark helpers; standard library only; no optional features or dependency changes
change: Drop the sorted endpoint Vec after its final use and before allocating DP scores; preserve initial allocation and comparison order

workloads.note: Existing weighted benchmark fixtures on a bounded subset; seed evolves across workloads, so these are not identical rows to the full historical harness run

measurement.method_order: deterministically shuffled before each sample using existing helper
measurement.timed_region: Entire algorithm call including temporary buffer destruction; excludes input setup, verification and destruction of returned output mask
measurement.memory: Separate untimed allocator pass; peak simultaneously live requested heap bytes, including output, excluding caller inputs, allocator metadata and OS RSS
measurement.allocation_counter: Same final shared allocation helper for before and after in one executable; counter disabled during runtime samples
measurement.oracle: Existing independent start-ordered suffix optimum plus feasibility/empty-interval verification after every allocation and timed run
measurement.execution: Sequential on host; no concurrent cargo builds or other agent benchmark workloads; no CPU affinity pinning

outcome.timing_claim: No runtime speedup claimed; per-case median after/before geometric means were 0.99969 and 1.00243 across the two runs; within-case timing spread was material

omissions: No Polars/Python end-to-end timing; change is confined to the pure core kernel
No RSS measurement; requested heap bytes are not RSS
No exhaustive geometry/distribution matrix or alternate endpoint types
Two preliminary scope-based runs were not accepted for the final source; retained only in target/rust-audit-weighted/scope-run*.csv
summary: rust-audit-weighted-summary.csv; median/min/max nanoseconds per workload and run; exact before/after versions from the same binary
